name: SpecStream
description: The live web data engine. One platform to build, search, extract, enrich, map, and monitor data across the entire web. Source URL and read time on every value.

apiKey.description: SpecStream API key, or a SecretRef. Falls back to the SPECSTREAM_API_KEY environment variable.

maxPriceUsd.description: The most one list may cost, in US dollars. Defaults to 5. The model can lower it per call and never raise it.

waitSeconds.description: How long specstream_find_list waits for a running list. Defaults to 300.

apiKey.label: SpecStream API key
apiKey.help: Create a key under Agents & API in your SpecStream workspace. Falls back to the SPECSTREAM_API_KEY environment variable.

maxPriceUsd.label: Price ceiling per list (USD)
maxPriceUsd.help: A list runs only if its quoted maximum is at or below this. The model can lower it per call and never raise it. Default 5.

waitSeconds.label: Wait for a running list (seconds)
waitSeconds.help: How long a find waits before returning the rows so far. Default 300.
